para.text: The "ToDo Grid" expert offers a great overview of all ToDo items that are present in your source code. The expert has a dockable main window; this mode should also be the primary form of use. Disadvantage of the dockable window is, that only a small amount of rows from the data grid is visible. To compensate for this limitation, a second, large and freely movable window can be opened which can displays the data grid with a significantly larger number of rows.

The extended functionality complements the to do function available in the IDE and offers new ways to keep a good overview by sorting, filtering and temporarily highlighting the data. This expert follows the well-known "To Do List" in many respects, but expands it with new features and expanded display options through the use of a string grid. The increased flexibility, especially in configuration, significantly improves adaptation to individual work situations.
